hidden.description: How many sessions of this workout are NOT in `sessions`. Zero means `sessions` is the complete history for this group; non-zero means it is not, and reading `sessions | length` as the whole history is then wrong. Two gates can withhold a row and this counts BOTH: the group's SCOPE (an auto-named group is matched by distance, so rides more than 10% away are a different group — and if the anchor recorded no distance at all, nothing can be matched to it), and the group's LENS (EF needs power and HR, speed/HR needs distance and HR, RPE needs a rating). The human render states the two causes separately — hidden for a scope drop, shown unscored for a lens drop — and never their sum; this is the machine half, where the sum is still meaningful because `sessions[]` omits both.

hidden_lens.description: How many of `hidden` were withheld by the group's LENS — the session is in this workout's history and the lens cannot score it (EF needs a normalized-power figure and a heart rate, speed/HR needs distance and a heart rate, RPE needs a rating). This is the FIXABLE half, though what fixes it depends on which input is missing: a heart-rate strap, a rating, or a power stream — an EF row is also refused when its load came from average watts rather than normalized power, which no amount of wearing a strap changes.

hidden_scope.description: How many of `hidden` were withheld by the group's SCOPE — the session belongs to a different slice of this workout. Auto-named groups (`Morning Ride` and friends) are matched by distance, so a ride more than 10% from the anchor's is a different group; and if the anchor recorded no distance at all, nothing can be matched to it. NOT fixable at the source, and not about the same training as the rows shown. `hidden_lens + hidden_scope == hidden`.
